content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need some advice. My simple project has expanded beyond what I originally planned. At first, I used a [product_name] module to control a fan and provide a reference signal to a VSD to adjust speed, connecting it to a machine interface panel. That part went well. Later, I needed more inputs, which required networking a second [product_name] module—again, no issues there. Now, at the last minute, the system needs to communicate with a [version_no] CPU to send alarm signals. I've checked various documents and videos, but my situation seems different. In most examples, the [product_name] acts as the client and the [version_no] CPU is the server, but in my setup it appears the [product_name] is the server and that can't be changed in [product_name] software. Will this cause any problems? Does the [product_name] need to be the client, or can it be the server? Had I known the full scope, I would have used a [version_no] CPU from the start, but that isn't feasible now. Any help would be appreciated.

The [product_name] module can function as either client or server. If it's set up as the server, you'll need to do more work in the [version_no] CPU program, specifically using PUT/GET commands. If the [product_name] is the client, PUT/GET isn't required.
In another part of the forum, I shared an example where the [product_name] is the server and the [version_no] CPU is configured as the client. The example file is named [document].
Without seeing your [product_name] program, I can't determine why it's not possible to switch the [product_name] to client mode. Please upload your [product_name] program as a ZIP file for review.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is dealing with integration challenges between two [company_name] controllers, specifically determining client-server roles for alarm communication. Initial functions worked well, but last-minute requirements brought complexities in networking and data exchange. Uncertainty about configuring client/server roles in the [product_name] software is causing project delays.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear guidelines for configuring client/server communication between controllers in [product_name] software and smooth alarm signal transmission between devices.
